title: DISTINCTCOUNTNOBLANK does not count the blank row's BLANK

source.quote: Unlike DISTINCTCOUNT function, DISTINCTCOUNTNOBLANK does not count the BLANK value
The number of distinct values in ColumnName, ignoring the blank value

derivation: Product[Color] holds Red, Blue, Red: 2 distinct non-blank values. Whether or not the blank row is a value of the column, a BLANK is not counted: 2.
